title: Provider & External Dependency Health
objective: Memantau provider timeout, throttling, authentication expiry, cost visibility, fallback, dan external transfer consent.
decision_rules: Tanpa observasi = BLOCKED tanpa klaim; coverage tidak lengkap atau catatan kosong = FAIL; provider failure timeout/throttling/availability/auth expiry wajib dipulihkan melalui fallback_success recovered; consent_failure wajib ok atau recovered; seluruh syarat terpenuhi = PASS.
limitations: Model menilai observasi lokal tercatat dan tidak melakukan request ke provider atau mengumpulkan credential.
Availability provider nyata, throttling live, authentication expiry aktual, biaya nyata, consent UI, hosted CI, signing, dan publikasi tetap DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
